title: Billing controls and filtered reports — rollout pending
notes: Atomic invoice saves, payment and credit history with reversals, approval before issue, and minimum billing quantities. All four new billing migrations are required before deployment.
Reports add date/customer/unit filters, paginated data, employee hours, separate currency and credit totals, CSV and print exports.
Combined-role access, safe PWA update defaults, disabled-by-default test login, lazy routes and isolated CI verification.
GitHub-only work in progress. Remaining packs, full backend verification and live rollout are not complete.
